{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print('\nFirst few rows:\n', df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nValue counts for customer_age:\n', df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print('\nRows with revenue == 999999.99:\n', df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nStatus distribution:\n', df['status'].value_counts())

# Check revenue column: is it really a string with commas?
print('\nSample of revenue values:\n', df['revenue'].head(10))"}
